dengue.name: Dengue
dengue.transmission: Dengue is primarily transmitted through the bite of infected Aedes mosquitoes.
prevention: Wear clothing that covers the arms and legs.
Use screens or other measures to reduce mosquito exposure.

malaria.name: Malaria
malaria.transmission: Malaria is transmitted through the bites of infected Anopheles mosquitoes.
prevention: Follow recommended malaria prevention measures when traveling to affected areas.

influenza.name: Influenza
influenza.transmission: Influenza can spread through respiratory droplets and particles from an infected person.
prevention: Stay home when sick when possible.
warning_signs: symptoms that improve and then become significantly worse
